nodes.label: KEA DESIGN S.R.L. – Ingeniería Electrónica partner logo
nodes.description: Logo for KEA DESIGN S.R.L., an electronic engineering company (Ingeniería Electrónica). Features a circular outline enclosing the monogram initials 'KD' rendered in a salmon-to-coral gradient. Below the emblem the full company name 'KEA DESIGN S.R.L.' appears in bold, followed by the subtitle 'INGENIERÍA ELECTRÓNICA' in lighter weight. Overall color palette is salmon/coral-to-orange gradient on a white background.
